picks.editorial_note: An OpenAI AI system reportedly produced a partial analytic proof and Lean formalization addressing the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem using roughly 10,000 autonomous agents — a striking demonstration of AI tackling one of mathematics' hardest open problems at scale.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: CERN and Mistral's strategic partnership to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions signals a major convergence of frontier AI and fundamental physics research, with implications for how large science collaborations adopt AI.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, aims to link national-lab supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a potentially transformative federal bet on AI-accelerated science.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ Southeastern universities, including Vanderbilt, to build shared advanced computing infrastructure marks a significant regional push to pool resources for AI and superintelligence research.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: Louisiana's bid to become an energy hub, backed by up to $250 billion in planned investment including a SpaceX spaceport and Meta's massive data center buildout, illustrates the scale of capital now flowing toward AI-driven infrastructure and energy demand.
picks.title: Large tech firms, small startups and universities are fueling Louisiana’s bid to become the energy hub of tomorrow

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to study light propagation through complex environments combines optical sensing and AI-driven inverse methods, representing a substantial defense-research investment with broad imaging applications.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: A $3.4 million share of a $20 million NSF-led project will let the University of Arkansas build AURORA, a robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory designed to dramatically accelerate the discovery of new quantum materials.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: University of Zurich's Rico Sennrich received the ACL's Test of Time Award for inventing subword tokenization (BPE) in 2016 — a technique now foundational to virtually every modern large language model, underscoring academia's lasting role in shaping today's AI.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model predicts protein motion dramatically faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a methodological advance that could broadly accelerate structural biology and drug discovery research.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: Brown University's role in the $28.6 million federally funded NATIVE-ID project to study protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease, including machine learning tools, represents a major multi-institution investment in AI-assisted biomedical research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease
